exposure: Laparoscopic management (evacuation of hematomas, removal of residual placental necrotic tissues, stitching of cesarean scars)
cohort: This study included two women admitted to a tertiary university hospital with vaginal bleeding and pelvic pain due to complications (cesarean-scar dehiscence and hematoma) following cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) terminations performed previously.
finding: The laparoscopic approach may be an efficient option for patients with particularly complicated cases of cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP).
